title: NHKマイルCの後に・遠い光

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Look at me! I made it through the NHK Mile Cup! My all-or-nothing effort took me to the tear-jerking light on the other side. Yes, it was that sublime…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: When I come to, I see both Opera O and Doto! You mean they actually came to check on me?! Apparently, they're both planning to run in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's gonna be the event of a lifetime! But Opera O's invitation also comes with a request—she wants to see how I perform on dirt. Looks like I'll have to put on a good show!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Will the radiance I saw on the turf today be the same on dirt? I'll find out in my next race—the Japan Dirt Derby!
